total_mass.quote: The detector consisted of an 18 m long, 690 ton steelscintillator target, followed by an iron-toroid spectrometer.

summary.plain: The 690-tonne steel-and-scintillator neutrino detector of Fermilab Lab E, followed by an iron-toroid muon spectrometer, calibrated with test beams of hadrons, electrons and muons.
summary.technical: 18 m long, 690 t target calorimeter of 168 steel plates (3 m x 3 m x 5.1 cm) with scintillator and drift chambers, followed by an iron-toroid spectrometer; continuously calibrated with a test beam; shared with CCFR.
